ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark-pixel) surface with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to sparse, discrete clusters; estimated ratio of 9:1 dark-to-light pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-pixel field across approximately 90% of the visible surface, with small high-contrast white punctate clusters (mottling) distributed primarily in the lower-central region and proximal to the trailing edges of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression at the central axis, measuring approximately 130-140 degrees with shallow pixel depth relative to the lobe span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Asymmetrical edge topography; the right lobe exhibits fine-scale, low-amplitude serrations, whereas the left lobe displays irregular, higher-amplitude indentations and notch-like variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge boundaries of both lobes, tapering toward acute, sharp-angled distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially discrete clusters of high-intensity circular pixels scattered against the dark ventral background, localized mainly in the lower central and right-central fluke regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct macro-indentation (missing tissue segment) is visible on the distal third of the left lobe's trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: The base of the fluke and the peduncle are partially occluded by the foreground presence of a second whale's dorsal fin and dorsal back surface.
